questions.prompt: Row [3, 1, 2] is bubble-sorted by the Token Grid State Machine. How many total comparisons and swaps happen?
questions.explanation: Bubble sort on a row of 3 makes a fixed number of comparisons regardless of order (3 here); swaps only happen when a pair is out of order, which totals 2 for this row.
